name: manual_957602
claim: When CodeRabbit comments on .agent memory archival, sanitize each archived JSON entry before computing its duplicate/archive identity and persist that exact sanitized object; otherwise duplicate detection can disagree with the tracked JSON representation and path-hygiene guarantees.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14 PR213 inline fix: .agent/memory/decay.py now calls sanitize_json_strings(entry), computes _archive_entry_id on that sanitized entry, writes the same object, and tests retry dedupe against sanitized persisted JSON.
